The '''dripdrinker larva''' was a type of [[Larva/Legends|larva]] that possessed a [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]].

Taking pride in their [[Sniper/Legends|marksmanship]], [[Churhee's Riflemen]] encouraged the rumor that their members could shoot the tongue off of a dripdrinker larva from a thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="GAW" />
